title: schema drift: the safe column entries tell a sealed package object to "publish the object", which cannot apply them
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRmmALkM1ftZxdVatQ

Filing gate: ④ loose end of PR #33769 (Part of #33724), named in its os-dev-report 6892684526 `loose_ends` item 1. Not filed earlier because the card covered NOT NULL only.

## What happens today

PR #33769 made the `relax_not_null` remedy text name the act per object kind. For an environment-authored object, the publish applies it. For a package object, a managed install or upgrade of the package applies it, through the new `relaxDeclaredNotNull` door. Either kind can use `os migrate apply`.

The other column entries the drift plan reports for a declared field still carry the environment-only sentence: `widen_date_to_datetime`, `widen_varchar` and `drop_column_default`. On origin/main see `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/schema-drift.ts:1540`: "… publishing the object applies it, or run \"os migrate apply\"."

On a sealed package object, the author cannot publish the object. A managed install has no door for these three ops either, because `relaxDeclaredNotNull` applies only the NOT NULL relax. So the sentence points the reader at an act that does nothing for them.

## Expected

Pick one, measured first:
- make the text name the act per object kind, the same way #33769 did for NOT NULL, with only `os migrate apply` named for a package object while no install door exists; or
- give the managed install a door for these safe ops as well, then name it.

The first option is text only. The second widens what an install does, so it needs a ruling before anyone builds it.

## Serial constraints

`schema-drift.ts` is also edited by #32883 (os-elon-musk) and queued for #33695. Serial behind both.
